variants.text: Young adult male with an oval face, thick dark arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and light stubble on his upper lip and chin. He has a small mole on his right cheek.

Young adult male with an oval face shape, thick dark eyebrows, and a straight nose. He has light stubble on his chin and upper lip, a small mole on his right cheek, and a straight hairline with slight temporal recession.

Young adult male with an oval face, medium forehead, and straight hairline showing slight temporal recession. Features include thick dark arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double eyelids, and a straight nose with a rounded tip. He has a defined jawline with a rounded chin, light stubble on the upper lip and chin, and a small mole on the right cheek.

This is a young man with an oval face, thick dark eyebrows, and a noticeable small mole on his right cheek. He has short stubble on his chin and mustache area, and his hair is receding slightly at the temples.
